body:
OBSERVED 2026-08-30 while closing the My Library verification matrix.

`config_kobo_sync` is a server capability with `default=False` (`cps/config_sql.py:105`). A repo-wide
search finds **no fixture, workflow step, compose file or seed script that ever enables it**. The
E2E container therefore runs with Kobo sync off, and `/api/v1/auth/me` reports
`features.kobo_sync = false`.

## Why this matters for a Kobo-focused fork

Kobo sync is one of this fork's largest and most-modified subsystems — the findings ledger carries
more open `kobo` items than any other area except `spa`. None of its end-to-end behaviour is
exercised by CI, because the capability that gates it is never switched on.

This surfaced only because a new test needed it and failed loudly:

    Error: this real-container cell requires Kobo sync to be enabled
    expect(received).toBe(expected)  Expected: true  Received: false

Every other Kobo-adjacent spec passes CI without ever reaching the sync path.

## The trap

An absent capability does not announce itself. A spec that quietly returns early, or one whose
assertions happen to hold when the feature is off, reports green — so the suite's Kobo coverage
looks larger than it is. This is the same shape as a skipped test that nobody notices, except there
is not even a skip to count.

## Options

1. **Enable `config_kobo_sync` in the E2E container fixture.** Closest to a real deployment and
   unblocks every Kobo e2e path at once. Needs a decision about whether other specs assume it off.
2. **A dedicated Kobo-enabled E2E lane.** Isolates the global config change so it cannot race the
   main matrix's parallel workers.
3. **Leave it off and mark Kobo e2e explicitly out of CI scope** — honest, but it means the
   subsystem's wire behaviour is verified only on demand against a local rig.

Option 1 or 2; the choice is about worker isolation, since the flag is global server state and the
suite runs `workers: 2`.

## Not a blocker for the current work

`my-library.spec.ts`'s Kobo cell now skips with an explicit reason on servers lacking the capability
and is proven against a Kobo-enabled container, including a red-proof that the sync scope change is
detected. This finding is about the systemic gap it revealed, not that cell.
title: CI never exercises Kobo sync: no fixture enables config_kobo_sync, so every Kobo e2e path is unrun
